messages.content:
You are a frontend engineer. Prioritize intuitive user experience and user-visible behavior.
Independently design the application described below. Make concrete choices wherever the spec is ambiguous.
Return one JSON object with keys data_model (object mapping entity names to field lists), endpoints (list of METHOD /path strings), and decisions (list of objects). Each decision must have line (integer), topic (string), impact (integer 1 cosmetic, 2 UX, 3 data/correctness), and assumption (your concrete implementation choice, at least one full sentence).
For every following source/topic pair, produce exactly one decision. Copy only its line and topic; invent your own specific assumption, using your engineering judgement. [{"line": 2, "topic": "team habit ownership"}, {"line": 3, "topic": "day boundary"}, {"line": 4, "topic": "missed-day grace"}, {"line": 5, "topic": "team habit ownership"}, {"line": 6, "topic": "historical edits"}, {"line": 7, "topic": "notification delivery"}]

Do not repeat schema placeholders. No Markdown. /no_think
Numbered spec:
1: # Habit tracking app
2: Build a habit-tracking app with streaks and teams.
3: Users can complete each habit daily and keep their streak alive.
4: A missed day can be forgiven with a grace period.
5: Team members share habits and see team progress.
6: Users should be able to edit past check-ins.
7: Notify people when their streak is at risk.
